page.t: Enter host or host:port, for example 192.168.1.20:47780
The password is sent once to the server and is never saved.
Choosing a team becomes available once the server offers it.
The server address is not valid. Use host or host:port.
The player name is too long. The limit is %d characters.
The multiplayer module is not ready. Check that X4Native and the X4MP library are installed.
Your X4 build is not supported. Install the build this X4MP version needs, or ask the host which build the session uses. %s
Your X4MP version or your mods do not match the server. Update X4MP or change your mods as the host asks. %s
The session is full. Try again later or ask the host for a free slot. %s
You are banned from this server. %s
That player name is already in use. Choose another name and join again. %s
